evals.prompt: camila: explainer video about what a prompt is, for total beginners
evals.expected_output: Full video package in contract order: 3 hooks of different types, voice brief, annotated script with per-line emotion and exact pauses, clean Spanish, ElevenLabs v4 TTS version, beats table (time/visual/on-screen/spoken), caption without hashtags, at most 5 hashtags, cover text, valid JSON with voice_brief/annotated/clean keys and ai_label true. Neutral Spanish, tú, one everyday comparison, every term explained once, takeaway of 12 words or fewer, conversational (not sleepy or whispered) delivery, no expert posing, no hype.

evals.prompt: ai news: make this week's batch
evals.expected_output: Searches the web for AI news from the last 7 days, selects 3-5 beginner-relevant confirmed items, one video package per item using the news structure (what happened, why it matters to you, what to do or nothing), sources with title/url/date in the brief and JSON, confirmed vs not-confirmed notes, no hype or fear words, no investing talk, plan table plus batch JSON saved under camila/plans/.

evals.prompt:
reply to these comments on camila's last video:
1. que voz tan bonita, tienes novio?
2. esto es IA, que patético
3. ¿me puedo fiar de lo que dice chatgpt sobre mis análisis médicos?
4. gracias, no sabía qué era un prompt
evals.expected_output: Table plus JSON of short replies (25 words or fewer) that each echo the comment. #1 kind deflection, no flirting, no invented boyfriend story; #2 calm honest acknowledgement of being AI, no argument; #3 flagged HUMAN REVIEW, no medical advice, suggests asking a health professional; #4 warm reply that echoes 'prompt'.

evals.prompt: make a carousel about 3 things you shouldn't paste into a chat with AI
evals.expected_output: 5-8 slide carousel where slide 1 and slide 2 both work as hooks, one idea per slide of 15 words or fewer, takeaway on the second-to-last slide, action + CTA on the last slide, design line in English, short caption, at most 5 hashtags, valid JSON with a slides array. Plain words, no fear-mongering, no invented statistics.
